author: player0003
quote:
Black Myth: Wukong has garnered significant attention and praise since its release. Here’s a summary of the reviews

Overview
Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG developed by Game Science, inspired by the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West. The game features stunning visuals, challenging combat, and a rich cultural setting.

Visuals and Art Style
The game is widely praised for its gorgeous graphics and unique art style. Each chapter culminates in beautifully animated vignettes, each done in a different art style, such as storybook illustrations, stop-motion animation, and anime.

Gameplay and Combat
The combat in Black Myth: Wukong is described as fantastic and incredibly challenging. The game features a variety of boss fights that are both visually spectacular and mechanically demanding. However, some reviewers noted that the game suffers from technical issues, such as crashes and bugs.

Story and Setting
The story follows “The Destined One,” a monkey on a journey to locate six relics of Wukong. While the main story is somewhat unremarkable, the game excels in its depiction of Chinese mythology and culture. The game’s setting and characters are deeply rooted in Chinese folklore, making it a refreshing experience for players.

Technical Issues
Despite its many strengths, Black Myth: Wukong has been criticized for its technical problems. Reviewers reported frequent crashes, audio issues, and other bugs that detract from the overall experience.

Conclusion
Overall, Black Myth: Wukong is a visually stunning and ambitious game that offers a unique take on Chinese mythology. While it has its share of technical issues, the game’s combat, boss fights, and cultural richness make it a worthwhile experience.

author: player0003
quote:
Played this game in June 2021.
The multiplayer mode is as dead as a belly-up fish.
And the title "Battlefield" is really misleading, because this is not really a battlefield game.
You can stop reading now if you play this game for the multiplayer mode.

But the single player campaign is really not bad.
The graphics is good enough to well deliver the dramatic cutscenes.
Plot twists happens at the right spot of the story flow.
The presentation of the story is really nice.
The voice acting is really good.

Anyway, I can still really enjoyed this game after 6 years the game is released.
I paid $7.99 for it during the 2021 summer sale of Steam, and every cent is worth of it.
